name: UnSub (10-hour autonomous agentic ransomware attack) — Unit 42
description: Unit 42 incident-response case: "a human attacker used frontier AI to breach an enterprise network autonomously." A recon agent mapped internal microservices; sub-agents scraped code repositories for hardcoded tokens/passwords; an agent infiltrated the secrets-management system for admin credentials; a pipeline/CI-CD agent hijacked workflows to exfiltrate cloud access keys; "specialist pivot agents" validated access across cloud, identity, CI-CD, container, and SaaS surfaces. The same agent fleet self-generated an "80-page, technical audit detailing dozens of exploited findings," left for the victim as extortion leverage. Total operational timeline: 10 hours, versus Unit 42's estimate of ~2 weeks for an equivalent human-led operation. *Analyst note: fully anonymized by Unit 42 — no group name, cluster ID, victim identity, sector, or nation-state link is given, unlike the LatAm clusters above which at least carry CL-CRI designators.* Unit 42
